milestones.title: Temperature scaling reframes confidence as a calibration problem
milestones.significance: A fitted probability can be systematically overconfident. Guo and colleagues evaluated post-processing calibration, including a single temperature parameter. The atlas connects this to separate calibration data, fixed model weights and explicit diagnostic bins; its six-case audit does not reproduce the paper’s experiments.

source.title: Temperature scaling reframes confidence as a calibration problem

milestones.title: Dense Passage Retrieval learns query and passage representations
milestones.significance: Karpukhin and colleagues trained separate query and passage encoders for retrieval. The bottleneck shifts from exact word matching to training and maintaining representations, an index and task-appropriate retrieval evidence. The atlas uses a tiny learned mean encoder, not the paper’s BERT-based system.

source.title: Dense Passage Retrieval learns query and passage representations

milestones.title: Denoising diffusion links learned noise prediction to generation
milestones.significance: Ho and colleagues developed a variational diffusion formulation with a simplified training objective. Iterative reverse computation connects noisy training examples to generation cost and quality. The atlas’s scalar nearest-neighbor denoiser demonstrates the equations within a much smaller approximation regime.

source.title: Denoising diffusion links learned noise prediction to generation

milestones.title: LoRA separates a frozen base from trainable low-rank changes
milestones.significance: Hu and colleagues proposed training rank-decomposition matrices while retaining pretrained weights. The method addresses adaptation-state cost; it does not imply every task or layer is adequately represented at a chosen small rank. The atlas distinguishes trainable state, optimizer storage and inference merging.

source.title: LoRA separates a frozen base from trainable low-rank changes

milestones.title: Structured state spaces connect long-sequence learning to recurrence and convolution
milestones.significance: Gu and colleagues introduced S4 with a structured state-space parameterization. The underlying recurrence/convolution relationship exposes alternatives for sequence computation and memory. The atlas’s scalar identity demonstrates that relationship without reproducing S4’s trained kernel or benchmark claims.

source.title: Structured state spaces connect long-sequence learning to recurrence and convolution

milestones.title: HumanEval emphasizes functional tests for synthesized code
milestones.significance: Chen and colleagues introduced a code benchmark that evaluates generated programs using tests. The change is in the evidence boundary: source text must satisfy executable behavior. The atlas tests four authored clamp candidates; it reports no code-model benchmark or pass@k estimate.

source.title: HumanEval emphasizes functional tests for synthesized code

milestones.title: Direct Preference Optimization changes the adaptation objective
milestones.significance: Rafailov and colleagues expressed preference optimization using a classification-style objective tied to a reference policy. This reduces the need for a separate online reinforcement-learning loop for that objective, while leaving preference quality, coverage and downstream task evaluation as distinct concerns.

source.title: Direct Preference Optimization changes the adaptation objective
